leadText:
Kayleigh (Japanese: カオリ Kaori) is a character of the day who appeared in Dreaming a Performer's Dream!. She is a Pokémon Performer from Brindille Town.

She was seen competing in the Rookie Class Pokémon Showcase in Lagoon Town with her . Her performance was going well until a suddenly appeared on the stage and crashed the performance. The Pancham jumped to the ceiling and grabbed a stage lamp, only to pull it down. As Pancham fell back onto the stage, Kayleigh ran off the stage in fear.
